A1.justification: Both complete PDFs describe the same KVTuner work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting and relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantization-error simulations, benchmark accuracy, search-pruning ablations, and GPU throughput measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original empirical results and adds LongBench evaluation and revised throughput measurements.

M1.justification: The offline precision search, intra-layer Pareto pruning, inter-layer clustering, calibration procedure, and application of searched configurations during inference remain unchanged. The new configuration table documents existing method outputs rather than introducing a component.

E1.justification: v4 adds evaluation on 20 LongBench datasets using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Section 6.3, Table 7), substantially extending direct long-context task coverage. The earlier WikiText, general QA, GSM8K, GPQA, and SoftAge conversation coverage is retained.

E2.justification: The throughput comparator set changes from FP16, KV8, and KV4 in v1 Table 7 to KV8, K8V4, KV4, and K4V2 in v4 Table 8. This adds asymmetric-precision controls and removes FP16 from that comparison; the principal KIVI and per-token-asym comparison families remain.

E3.justification: The throughput evaluation changes from Llama2-7B with method-specific maximum batch sizes and 512–8192 input tokens to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with common batch/input-length pairs of 64/128, 16/512, and 8/1024. Appendix D.3 also explicitly extends the Qwen2.5-7B KIVI search from 200 to 500 iterations. These are reported experimental-setting changes, not same-setting performance comparisons.

E4.justification: Appendix D.2 extends analysis of search outputs: Table 11 supports examining how 6–8 layer groups use only 2–5 distinct precision pairs and how assignments vary with depth. The existing pruning ablations and attention-pattern, prompt, and quantization-mode sensitivity analyses are retained.

E5.justification: No repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical testing procedures are added or revised. The increase to 500 optimization iterations concerns the search budget, not independent repetitions or uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: v4 adds LongBench scores, including 0.7903 for KIVI KVTuner-C3.92 versus 0.7956 for BF16, and replaces the throughput results with measurements under different conditions. It also updates the Qwen KIVI search frontier. Matched GSM8K, GPQA, and general-task accuracy tables remain unchanged apart from rounding. Section 6.2 introduces a conflicting 3.92-bit description where the retained Llama result in Table 5 is 3.25-bit.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, optimization formulation, Lemma 1, and its quantization-error derivation remain unchanged. The proof moves from Appendix A.1 to Appendix A; stronger emphasis on theoretical analysis does not add a formal result.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction revise the headline throughput improvement from 38.3% over KV8 to 21.25% over KIVI-KV8, reflecting the replacement evaluation. The central sensitivity-aware tuning contribution and nearly lossless 3.25-bit/4-bit compression claims remain.

C2.justification: Appendix D.2 adds interpretation of final assignments as evidence against simple layer-depth heuristics. Section 6.4 expands the efficiency explanation through memory movement and precision-dependent kernel costs, and identifies the timed KIVI kernel's Llama-series scope. The principal attention-pattern and error-accumulation interpretations remain.

D1.justification: v4 supplies a code/configuration repository address and detailed final per-layer assignments for three models and both quantization modes in Table 11, substantially improving reproducibility beyond v1's candidate sets and clusters. Throughput timing explicitly includes quantization/dequantization overhead. However, the replacement benchmark does not retain v1's explicit L40 48GB GPU and 128-output-token specifications.

R1.justification: v4 adds citations to LongBench, chain-of-thought prompting, and RagCache. The existing positioning relative to KV compression and inference methods remains largely unchanged; numerous preprint-to-publication reference updates concern the same works.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main narrative sequence are retained. Local heading and terminology edits, an expanded throughput explanation, a new Impact Statement, and regrouping the appendices into A–F refine the document structure.

P2.justification: The main text changes from single-column to two-column conference layout, with extensive resizing and relocation of displays. The framework moves from Figure 4 to front-page Figure 1, the fuller appendix accuracy table becomes main Table 5 with color highlighting, new LongBench and configuration tables appear, and the throughput table is redesigned. Most existing plot content is retained.

improvement.justification: The LongBench evaluation, throughput measurements tied to the accuracy-tested model/configurations, and explicit final assignments and code-access information provide a modest net improvement in validation and reproducibility. These gains are tempered by aggregate-only LongBench reporting, loss of the earlier longer-context throughput and hardware details, and the new Section 6.2 precision inconsistency with Table 5.
